name: Basketry cane and reed
definition: cane or reed sold for weaving baskets.
notes: Shop lists Round and Flat Reed, Chair Cane, Binder Cane as separate product categories; spline, seagrass, rush also sold.

name: Raffia
definition: palm-fibre strand sold for weaving and craft.
notes: Natural raffia sold in 250 g bundles for crafts, tying and gift wrap; also listed with rush and seat-weaving supplies.

name: Floral foam
definition: absorbent foam made to hold stems in arrangements.
notes: Sold as bricks, blocks, spheres, sheets, wreaths and caged shapes; wet and dry foam.

name: Florist wire
definition: wire made for binding and supporting stems.
notes: Painted green gauge wire cut lengths and spools; binding and decorative wire also listed.

name: Craft wood blank and shape
definition: wooden plaque, shape or blank sold for crafts.
notes: Wood surfaces sold by shape (circles, geometric, organic, seasonal) and species; plaques for decorating and burning.

name: Turning blank
definition: wood blank sold for craft turning.
notes: Sold as bowl, spindle and pen blanks; square blanks 2x2 to 4x4 in; pen blanks also in acrylic and resin.

name: Pyrography pen
definition: heated pen made for burning designs into wood.
notes: Sold as fixed-tip and wire-tip pens with burner or in kits; also used for leather and hot-knife cutting.

name: Craft scissors
definition: scissors made for craft cutting (K-171).
notes: Craft scissors sold apart from sewing, kitchen and kids scissors; precision applique scissors also sold.

name: Rotary cutter
definition: wheel-bladed hand cutter for fabric and paper.
notes: Sold by blade size 18 to 60 mm for patchwork, quilting and sewing.

name: Craft knife (hobby knife)
definition: small replaceable-blade knife for craft cutting.
notes: Sold as craft, art and graphic knives with replaceable blades, under craft and artistry uses.

name: Cutting mat
definition: self-healing mat that protects the work surface during cutting.
notes: Self-healing mats sold for rotary cutting, craft knives and sewing; sizes and sides vary.

name: Craft cutting machine (Cricut-type)
definition: electronic cutting plotter for paper, vinyl and fabric (K-172).
notes: Sold as smart cutting machines cutting paper, vinyl, leather and fabric.

name: Heat press
definition: press that applies heat and pressure to transfer designs onto fabric and other blanks (K-172).
notes: Sold as flat, hand-held, mug and hat presses for iron-on, sublimation and infusible ink.

name: Craft glue (PVA and other liquid craft glues)
definition: liquid glue made for crafts (K-171).
notes: Tacky glue, fabric glue and general crafting adhesives sold as a shop category.

name: Hot-glue gun
definition: electric gun that melts glue sticks for craft bonding.
notes: Crafting glue guns sold in mini and full size, corded or cordless, dual temperature.

name: Spray adhesive
definition: aerosol adhesive made for crafts.
notes: Sold as craft adhesive sprays, heavy-duty and repositionable.

name: Airbrush
definition: compressed-air spray tool made for fine painting of pictures and models.
notes: Sold single or in sets, single or double action, gravity or side feed.

name: Craft paint (for decorating objects, by surface)
definition: paint made for decorating craft objects (K-172).
notes: Acrylic craft paint sold by finish and by surface, e.g. multi-surface and outdoor.

name: Presser foot
definition: interchangeable foot that holds fabric under a sewing-machine needle.
notes: Feet sold per machine brand and shank type, singly or in foot kits.

name: Machine needle
definition: needle made for a sewing machine.
notes: Sold by needle system (130/705 H, 15x1), point type and size.

name: Extension table
definition: table that clips to a sewing machine to enlarge the bed.
notes: Sold per machine or universal, acrylic or plastic, for free-arm, embroidery and serger machines.

name: Bobbin
definition: spool that holds the lower thread of a sewing machine.
notes: Bobbins sold by class (Class 66) in 10-packs; bobbin cases listed separately.

name: Airbrush compressor
definition: compressor made to drive an airbrush (S3).
notes: Sold as piston compressors for airbrushing, with or without tank.
